channel.title: Andrew Brogdon · Writing & Poetry

item.title: Flutter’s multiplatform value for agentic development

item.title: New updates to A2UI and Flutter’s GenUI package
item.description: Architectural changes to the genui package, detailing how the A2UI protocol connects autonomous agents with client-side widget catalogs.

item.title: Harness the Gemini API in your Dart and Flutter Apps
item.description: A hands-on guide to integrating multimodal generative AI models into client applications with the Dart Gemini SDK.
